{{Term/Store|Monster Part|Monster Parts|Series, BotW, TotK|plural}},{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}}<ref name="BotW Chef Aurie Taamu, Vol. 1"/><ref name="TotK A Note to Our Hylian Workers"/> also known as '''Monster Materials''',{{Exp Game|TotK}}<ref name="TotK Cormus"/> are a recurring class of [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Name Ref|AoC}}

==Location and Uses==
==={{BotW|-}}===
Monster Parts are a type of [[Material]] dropped by [[Monster]]s when they are defeated.<ref name="BotW Piggyback"/> Higher-ranking Monster Parts can be dropped by higher-ranking [[Enemy|Enemies]]. For example, [[Bokoblin Horn]]s can be dropped by all [[Bokoblin]]s, but [[Bokoblin Guts]] will only be dropped by [[Blue Bokoblin]]s or higher. Materials dropped from [[Creature]] that can deal damage to [[Link]], like [[Boar]]s or [[Wolf|Wolves]], are not considered Monster Parts.

Monster Parts can be sold to [[Shop]] and [[Merchant]]s all around [[Hyrule]] for varying prices. Rarer Monster Parts will sell for higher amounts of [[Rupee]]s. [[Kilton]], the proprietor of the [[Fang and Bone]], accepts Monster Parts in exchange for his currency, [[Mon]].

All Monster Parts can be [[Cooking|Cooked]] with [[Lizard]]s and [[Insect]]s to make [[Elixir]]s, and their duration will vary based on the part included.<ref name="BotW Piggyback"/> If Cooked by themselves, Monster Part will only create [[Dubious Food]].
